frontmatter.title: Laboratory Task 2 — Forward Pass and Error Computation

children.value: Perform a single forward pass and compute for the error.
Step 0 — Set Up Inputs, Weights, and Biases

children.label: Step 0 — Set Up Inputs, Weights, and Biases

children.value:
import numpy as np

# Inputs
x = np.array([1, 0, 1], dtype=float)
y = np.array([1], dtype=float)

# Activation function: ReLU
def relu(z):
    return np.maximum(0, z)

# Hidden unit weights
W1 = np.array([
    [0.2, -0.3],   # w11, w12  (from x1)
    [0.4,  0.1],   # w13, w14  (from x2)
    [-0.5, 0.2]    # w15, w16  (from x3)
])
b1 = np.array([-0.4, 0.2])   # theta1, theta2

# Output unit weights 
W2 = np.array([
    [-0.3],   # w21
    [-0.2]    # w22
])
b2 = np.array([0.1])   # theta3

print("x  =", x)
print("y  =", y)
print("W1 =\n", W1)
print("b1 =", b1)
print("W2 =\n", W2)
print("b2 =", b2)
